decisions.reason: Because this binder is close to the firm’s core finishing range and can be supported with existing service, parts, and sales capabilities in a growing market, there is no strong sign of performance below aspiration even though overlap with other binding offers makes it somewhat more droppable than the others.

The fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm’s stated direction toward automation and productivity, so under bounded rationality and with no clear evidence of failure the firm would likely retain it rather than search for an alternative use of the resources.

The booklet maker for inline and nearline matches the firm’s digital print finishing focus and broad portfolio logic, and with industry conditions not adverse the product is likely to stay unless later results clearly fall short of aspiration.
